If hr stays 0 even fully-fit, that is stronger evidence the ceiling is STRUCTURAL (the FBP self-supervision target itself caps N2I), which is the documented finding. (5) BUDGET: warm-start ep=3 (~130s) + 200 scans * 7.0s = 1400s + figure ~= 26 min... TOO LONG for 30-min wall.
